title: Role of the Casimir force in the capacitive radio-frequency microelectromechanical switches
summary: We determine the role of the fluctuation-induced Casimir force acting between a membrane of cylindrical shape and a bottom electrode in microelectromechanical capacitive switches. For this purpose, the Casimir force is computed taking into account the real properties of both a membrane and a bottom electrode materials with account of surface roughness. The obtained results are compared with those found for the smooth surfaces using the idealization of ideal metal.
